gap: No result ChatGPT got states that Tenergy's TN480U charger kits come with no wall adapter, only a Micro-USB cable, and need a 5 V 2 A USB supply, or that Tenergy's own 20 W charger in the same store has only a USB-C port and no cable, so it won't work with the cable in the box.
standout_why: I read geekchamp.com/best-rechargeable-batteries-for-aa-and-aaa-devices-2026 (cited), rottenwifi.com/best-rechargeable-batteries-for-aa-and-aaa-devices (rank 1), gomyreview.com/5-top-rated-rechargeable-batteries-with-charger and the cited IKEA STENKOL/LADDA page. Geekchamp and RottenWifi already warn against putting 1.5 V lithium cells in a NiMH-only charger, against pair charging and against mixing cells, so those traps aren't new. None of these pages mentions Tenergy, a kit that ships without a wall adapter, the 5 V 2 A input, or which plug fits which cable. GoMyReview only says to 'check the current Amazon listing if charger input type, included cable… matters'. This finding decides the set: a Tenergy cart needs a third item, and the obvious one in the same store (the 20 W PD charger, USB-C only, no cable) doesn't fit the cable in the box. Caveat: I couldn't read the two other cited pages. Digital Camera World came back truncated and theconsumerlibrary.com failed with an SSL error.
kit_items: Charger and batteries: Tenergy Combo TN480U 8-bay NiMH charger with 8 Premium Pro AA (2,800 mAh) and 8 Premium Pro AAA (1,100 mAh). Tenergy is an approved store and Dealectric already lists the TN480U and Premium Pro AA. It covers both sizes, like the EBL 8-bay kit ChatGPT showed.

USB wall power: Tenergy 18W Fast USB Charger Combo Kit (wall charger, car charger and 2 × 6 ft USB-to-Micro-USB cables). Its 5 V output is rated 2 A, which matches the TN480U's 'DC 5V 2A' input, and its cables have the same connector as the one in the TN480U box. Don't use the Tenergy USB-C PD 20W charger here: it has a USB-C port only and comes with no cable.

findings.label: Wall adapter included
findings.value: No. The page says 'Micro-USB to AC power adapter is NOT included'. The box holds the batteries, 1 TN480U charger, 1 Micro USB cable and 1 user manual.
findings.source_title: Tenergy Combo TN480U 8-Bay NiMH Battery LCD Display Fast Charger + 8 Pack Premium Pro AA and 8 Pack Premium Pro AAA
findings.note: Maker's US store page. Price $47.99 the same day. The 8-AA-only combo ($42.99) carries the same 'NOT included' line and the same Micro USB cable.

findings.label: Input requirement
findings.value: DC 5 V 2 A, through Micro-USB or USB-C
findings.source_title: Tenergy TN480U 8-Bay NiMH Battery LCD Display Fast Charger, Micro USB/Type C Input
findings.note: Charger-only listing, $23.99. Package contents list '1 x Tenergy TN480U Charger' and nothing else, so neither a cable nor an adapter is listed.

findings.label: Charge current per slot
findings.value: AA 500 mA, AAA 250 mA, 1 to 8 cells, no pairing needed
findings.source_title: Tenergy TN480U 8-Bay NiMH Battery LCD Display Fast Charger, Micro USB/Type C Input
findings.note: Page text: 'Fully recharge 1-8 AA/AAA NiMH without pairs'. My arithmetic, not a maker figure: 8 × 0.5 A at roughly 1.4–1.5 V NiMH charge voltage is about 6 W going into the cells, against the 10 W (5 V × 2 A) rated input. That's why an old 5 V 1 A (5 W) phone cube is below what the charger is rated for.

findings.label: Ports and cable
findings.value: One USB-C output, 5 V 3 A / 9 V 2.22 A. The page says 'Charging cable: not included'.
findings.note: $15.99. The cable in the TN480U kit has a USB-A plug on one end and Micro-USB on the other, so it can't plug into this charger. Using it would mean buying another cable as well.

findings.product: Tenergy 18W Fast USB Charger Combo Kit
findings.label: 5 V output and contents
findings.value: 5 V 2 A / 9 V 2 A / 12 V 1.5 A, 18 W max. Box: 1 wall charger, 1 car charger, 2 × 6 ft USB-to-Micro-USB cables, 1 manual.
findings.source_title: Tenergy 18W Fast USB Charger Combo Kit
findings.note: $19.99, in stock, free shipping. Its 5 V 2 A output matches the TN480U's input. The included 'USB to Micro USB' cables suggest a USB-A port, but the page doesn't name the port type.

findings.label: Capacity, self-discharge, cycles, warranty
findings.value: AA 2,800 mAh, AAA 1,100 mAh, 1.2 V NiMH. The page says it 'Retains 85% capacity after 1 year in storage', rates the cells for up to 1,200 recharges, and gives a 12-month warranty on charger and batteries.
findings.source_title: Tenergy Combo TN480U … 8 Pack Premium Pro AA and 8 Pack Premium Pro AAA

findings.label: Battery limits and power
findings.value: The page says to 'Charge only Ni-MH type rechargeable batteries with minimum capacity 500mAh (AAA) or 1000mAh (AA)'. The charger plugs directly into a wall socket and has four independent channels. Charging takes about 8 h for 4 cells and about 4 h for 2. Price $18.98.
findings.source_title: STENKOL / LADDA battery charger and 4 batteries - IKEA
findings.note: Shown for contrast: ChatGPT's budget pick needs no adapter. The page's own contents conflict: the packaging section says LADDA 1900 mAh, while the 'Complete with' section shows LADDA 750 mAh.
